title: Affine differential sections map is bijective
statement: For affine opens U and V as above, every Γ(X,U)-linear map from Ω_{Γ(X,U)/Γ(S,V)} to Γ(U,Ω_{X/S}) that sends da to d_{X/S}a is bijective.

proof.text: Use the affine Spec comparison and the uniqueness part of the universal property of Kähler differentials to identify the compatible map with the canonical affine isomorphism; hence it is bijective.
